check: Production (not staging/localhost) is the environment being audited; confirm via response headers or robots.txt diff.
recommended_fix: Re-point crawler and manual checks at the live production host.
validation_method: Diff staging vs. production robots.txt and headers

check: Representative URL sample is drawn from every page template (home, category, product/service, article, location), not domain-wide only.
recommended_fix: Tag crawl export by template before analysis; re-sample under-represented templates.
validation_method: Confirm sample count per template ≥ statistically useful minimum

check: Baseline metrics are recorded before remediation: index coverage, impressions, clicks, and Core Web Vitals status.
recommended_fix: Export and timestamp baseline reports before any fix ships.
validation_method: Compare post-fix reports against this dated baseline

check: Crawl data is corroborated with at least one additional source (Search Console index coverage, and server logs where available).
dependency: Search Console access; log access if available
recommended_fix: Cross-reference crawler-reported status codes against Search Console and logs.
validation_method: Discrepancy count between sources trends to zero

check: Every finding in this workbook links to a URL, screenshot, or report line rather than a subjective note.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: This workbook, Evidence URL column populated
recommended_fix: Reject any row without a populated Evidence URL or screenshot column.
validation_method: Spot-check 10% of rows for evidence presence

check: robots.txt does not block CSS, JS, or sections required for rendering or indexing.
recommended_fix: Remove disallow rules blocking required assets or sections.
validation_method: Re-fetch robots.txt; re-render URL in URL Inspection

check: HTTP status codes are correct per URL state: 200 for live, 301 for moved, 404/410 for removed, no soft-404s.
recommended_fix: Fix server-side status codes; replace soft-404s with true 404/410 or a real redirect.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm status-code distribution
rollback_requirement: Yes — verify redirect map before deploy

check: Redirect chains are collapsed to a single hop; no redirect loops exist.
recommended_fix: Point each redirect directly at the final destination URL.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm chain length = 1

check: XML sitemap(s) list only canonical, indexable, 200-status URLs, and are referenced in robots.txt.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Sitemap file + Search Console sitemap report
recommended_fix: Regenerate sitemap excluding non-canonical, noindex, and non-200 URLs.
validation_method: Search Console sitemap report shows 0 excluded-by-mistake URLs

check: Sitemap URLs are all crawlable and return 200 within a normal crawl budget (no orphaned or blocked sitemap entries).
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Crawler cross-check of sitemap vs. crawl
recommended_fix: Remove or fix sitemap entries that 404, redirect, or are blocked.
validation_method: Cross-check sitemap URLs against crawl report

check: robots meta tag and X-Robots-Tag header are consistent and intentional per template (no conflicting signals).
recommended_fix: Standardize robots directives per template; remove conflicting header/meta combinations.
validation_method: Spot-check response headers vs. rendered meta tag per template

check: noindex is applied only to intended URLs (filters, thin pages, internal search results) and not to revenue pages.
recommended_fix: Remove noindex from revenue-bearing templates; confirm intended noindex list with stakeholders.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm noindex list matches intended list

check: Internal links use crawlable <a href> anchors; no link-dependent content is JS-click-only or button-only.
recommended_fix: Replace JS-only click handlers with real anchor elements.
validation_method: Rendered-HTML link count matches expected navigation

check: No important page is orphaned (zero internal inlinks) per crawler link-graph report.
recommended_fix: Add internal links from at least one relevant hub or listing page.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm inlink count > 0 for prior orphans

check: Crawl budget is not wasted on faceted/parameterized URL combinations without commercial value.
recommended_fix: Apply robots/canonical/parameter rules per TSA-081–088.
validation_method: Crawl stats show reduced parameterized-URL crawl share

check: Server responds to crawler user agents (Googlebot, Bingbot) the same way it responds to standard browsers (no cloaking).
recommended_fix: Remove user-agent-based content or status differences.
validation_method: Compare fetch-as-Googlebot output to standard browser output

check: Crawl stats in Search Console show stable or improving crawl requests and average response time, not a downward host-health trend.
recommended_fix: Investigate server response-time regressions or crawl demand drops.
validation_method: Monitor crawl stats trend over the following 4 weeks

check: Canonical tags are self-referencing on indexable pages, or point to the correct preferred URL on duplicates.
recommended_fix: Fix canonical tag logic per template to point at the preferred URL.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm canonical/actual URL match rate

check: Indexed URL count in Search Console is consistent with the count of intentionally indexable URLs (no large unexplained gap).
recommended_fix: Investigate and resolve the specific exclusion reasons driving the gap.
validation_method: Re-check Page Indexing report after fixes propagate

check: 'Crawled — currently not indexed' count is investigated per template, not dismissed as normal.
recommended_fix: Improve content depth/uniqueness or consolidate thin duplicate templates.
validation_method: Track this exclusion count trend over time

check: 'Discovered — currently not indexed' URLs are checked for crawl-budget or quality causes.
recommended_fix: Improve internal linking and page quality signals for affected URLs.
validation_method: Track this exclusion count trend over time

check: Duplicate content clusters (parameter variants, trailing slash, http/https, www/non-www) resolve to one canonical version.
recommended_fix: Standardize on one URL form site-wide with 301s and matching canonicals.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm single indexable form per cluster

check: HTTPS is enforced site-wide with valid certificates and no mixed-content warnings.
recommended_fix: Force HTTPS redirects and fix mixed-content resource references.
validation_method: Re-check for mixed-content console warnings

check: hreflang tags (if multi-locale) are reciprocal and reference self, with no orphaned or mismatched entries.
recommended_fix: Fix reciprocal hreflang pairs and remove orphaned entries.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm hreflang reciprocity

check: Pagination pages (page 2, 3…) are indexable and distinct, not noindexed or duplicated, where they hold unique product/listing value.
recommended_fix: Set intentional index/noindex per pagination page based on unique value.
validation_method: Re-crawl paginated series and confirm intended status

check: URL structure is descriptive, stable, and free of unnecessary query-string noise on canonical/indexable pages.
recommended_fix: Simplify URL patterns for new sections; avoid changing existing indexed URLs without a redirect plan.
validation_method: Review new URL patterns before launch

check: 404 and other error pages return the correct status code and are not being indexed.
recommended_fix: Confirm error templates return true 404/410, not 200.
validation_method: Re-crawl error URLs and confirm status code

check: Redirected legacy URLs from prior migrations still resolve correctly (no accumulated redirect rot).
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Redirect map audit vs. live crawl
recommended_fix: Test a sample of historical redirects; fix any broken or chained entries.
validation_method: Sample-test 20+ historical redirects quarterly

check: Search Console has no manual actions and Security Issues is clear.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Search Console Manual Actions / Security Issues report
recommended_fix: Resolve the specific manual action or security issue per Google's guidance before any other indexation work.
validation_method: Confirm report shows no issues after fix

check: International or multi-brand domains are not competing for the same query intent (cannibalization at the domain level).
recommended_fix: Differentiate targeting or consolidate overlapping properties.
validation_method: Monitor query overlap over the following quarter

check: Revenue-critical pages are reachable within 3 clicks of the homepage or a primary entry point.
recommended_fix: Add navigation or hub-page links to reduce click depth.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm click depth ≤ 3 for target set

check: Hub/category pages link down to their children and across to sibling categories.
recommended_fix: Add child and sibling links to hub templates.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm bidirectional linking

check: Breadcrumbs are present, accurate, and reflect the real site hierarchy.
recommended_fix: Fix breadcrumb logic to match the real IA; add BreadcrumbList schema.
validation_method: Rich Results Test on a sample of templates

check: Primary navigation is present in server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML, not injected only after user interaction.
recommended_fix: Ensure navigation markup exists in the initial HTML response.
validation_method: Compare raw HTML vs. rendered HTML for nav presence

check: Footer links do not carry the majority of a page's outbound link equity to unrelated or low-value pages.
recommended_fix: Trim footer link count and point remaining links at genuinely relevant pages.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm footer link count reduction

check: Anchor text used for internal links is descriptive of the destination, not generic ('click here', 'read more') on important paths.
recommended_fix: Rewrite anchor text on high-value internal links to be descriptive.
validation_method: Spot-check anchor text on top 20 linked pages

check: Topic-cluster pillar and supporting pages link to each other in both directions where relevant.
recommended_fix: Add missing pillar-to-child and child-to-pillar links.
validation_method: Spot-check cluster linking coverage

check: Sitewide link count per page is reasonable for the template type (not thousands of low-value links diluting equity).
recommended_fix: Reduce non-essential link blocks on affected templates.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm link count per page trend

check: Related-content modules link to genuinely relevant pages, not a static or randomized unrelated set.
recommended_fix: Fix related-content selection logic to use topical relevance.
validation_method: Spot-check related-content relevance on a sample

check: Mobile navigation exposes the same crawlable link set as desktop (no mobile-only hidden sections that drop links).
recommended_fix: Ensure mobile nav markup contains the same links as desktop, even if visually collapsed.
validation_method: Compare mobile vs. desktop rendered link sets

check: Primary content and headings are present in the rendered HTML (post-JS-execution), not only in raw source.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: URL Inspection rendered HTML / rendering tool screenshot
recommended_fix: Fix client-side rendering gaps with SSR, SSG, or dynamic rendering for bots.
validation_method: Compare rendered vs. expected content per template

check: Critical internal links are present as real anchors in the rendered DOM, not generated only on click/hover.
recommended_fix: Render link markup server-side rather than on interaction.
validation_method: Inspect rendered DOM for anchor presence

check: Rendering does not depend on a required user action (scroll-triggered infinite load, click-to-reveal) for indexable content.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Rendered HTML review with no interaction
recommended_fix: Provide a crawlable paginated or SSR fallback for infinite-scroll content.
validation_method: Fetch rendered HTML with no simulated interaction and confirm content presence

check: Rendering budget/timeout is sufficient for the page's JS execution time (no partial renders under crawler time limits).
recommended_fix: Reduce JS execution time or pre-render heavy templates.
validation_method: Re-test render completeness after optimization

check: Structured data is present in the rendered DOM if it is injected client-side, not only in an unexecuted script tag.
recommended_fix: Move schema injection to server-side render or confirm client injection completes before crawl.
validation_method: Rich Results Test against the live URL

check: Client-side redirects (JS-based) are replaced with server-side (301/302) redirects wherever feasible.
recommended_fix: Move redirect logic to the server/CDN layer.
validation_method: Confirm HTTP-level redirect via response headers

check: Lazy-loaded images below the fold still resolve to a real src (or valid srcset) in rendered HTML, not a placeholder only.
recommended_fix: Ensure lazy-load implementation sets a real image source attribute.
validation_method: Inspect rendered HTML for placeholder-only images

check: Framework-level metadata (title, meta description, canonical) is set per route at render time, not left at a default/shared value.
recommended_fix: Wire per-route metadata into the rendering layer.
validation_method: Sample rendered HTML head across templates for uniqueness

check: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) is at or under 2.5 seconds at the 75th percentile, using field data where available.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: PageSpeed Insights / CrUX / Search Console CWV report
recommended_fix: Optimize the LCP element: preload, compress, remove render-blocking resources.
validation_method: Re-measure 75th-percentile field LCP after 28-day CrUX window

check: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) is at or under 200 milliseconds at the 75th percentile.
recommended_fix: Reduce main-thread blocking time and long tasks triggered by interactions.
validation_method: Re-measure 75th-percentile field INP after 28-day CrUX window

check: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) is at or under 0.1.
recommended_fix: Reserve space for images/ads/embeds and avoid late-injected content above existing content.
validation_method: Re-measure CLS after fix ships

check: Core Web Vitals are assessed on mobile as the primary device class, not desktop only.
recommended_fix: Re-run all CWV checks against mobile field/lab data specifically.
validation_method: Confirm mobile-specific CWV report is the primary reference

check: Render-blocking CSS/JS on the critical rendering path is minimized for top templates.
recommended_fix: Defer non-critical CSS/JS; inline critical CSS where appropriate.
validation_method: Re-run diagnostics and confirm reduced blocking-resource count

check: Images are served in modern formats, correctly sized, and compressed for their rendered dimensions.
recommended_fix: Convert to modern formats and serve responsive, compressed sizes.
validation_method: Re-run image audit and confirm savings realized

check: Fonts are loaded with a strategy that avoids invisible text and layout shift (font-display, preloading key fonts).
recommended_fix: Set font-display and preload key font files.
validation_method: Re-check for FOIT/FOUC and layout shift from font swap

check: Third-party scripts (tags, widgets, ads) are audited and any with disproportionate performance cost are deferred or removed.
recommended_fix: Defer, lazy-load, or remove low-value third-party scripts.
validation_method: Re-run third-party audit and confirm reduced blocking time

check: Server response time (TTFB) is within a healthy range for the hosting/CDN setup.
recommended_fix: Improve caching, use a CDN, or upgrade hosting tier.
validation_method: Re-measure TTFB after infra change

check: A CWV regression-monitoring process exists so a code deploy that degrades performance is caught before or shortly after release.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: CI performance budget or monitoring dashboard config
recommended_fix: Add a performance budget gate to CI or a scheduled CWV monitoring job.
validation_method: Confirm alert fires on an intentional test regression

check: Above-the-fold content does not depend on a large hero video/animation that delays LCP.
recommended_fix: Replace or defer heavy hero media; use a lightweight poster/placeholder.
validation_method: Re-measure LCP after change

check: Mobile page weight (transferred bytes) is reasonable for the target markets' typical connection speeds.
recommended_fix: Reduce payload via compression, code-splitting, and asset trimming.
validation_method: Re-measure transferred bytes after optimization

check: Every content/article template includes Article or BlogPosting schema with headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, and image.
recommended_fix: Add or complete the recommended Article/BlogPosting properties per template.
validation_method: Rich Results Test on a sample of URLs per template

check: Structured data reflects the content actually visible on the page — no markup for content that is not present or has been removed.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Rich Results Test vs. rendered page comparison
recommended_fix: Remove or correct schema fields that do not match visible content.
validation_method: Manual comparison of schema fields vs. rendered page

check: Only valid, currently supported schema.org types are used; deprecated or unsupported rich-result types are identified and treated as informational schema, not a rankings/rich-result lever.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Schema markup validator + Search Console Enhancements report
recommended_fix: Confirm current eligibility per type before relying on it for a rich-result claim; document any type that no longer produces a rich result even if still valid schema.
validation_method: Re-check Search Console Enhancements report and current Google documentation

check: FAQPage schema, if used, matches the visible FAQ content exactly and its current rich-result eligibility is documented rather than assumed.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Schema/visible-content diff + current Google documentation check
recommended_fix: Keep FAQ schema in sync with visible FAQ text; do not represent FAQ schema as guaranteed to produce a search rich result if current guidance says otherwise.
validation_method: Diff schema.faqItems against rendered FAQ block on every publish

check: BreadcrumbList schema matches the visible breadcrumb trail and site hierarchy.
recommended_fix: Sync BreadcrumbList schema generation with the rendered breadcrumb component.
validation_method: Rich Results Test on a sample of templates

check: Organization/WebSite schema (sitewide) includes accurate name, logo, and sameAs entity links.
recommended_fix: Add or correct sitewide Organization schema fields.
validation_method: Validate against schema.org and Rich Results Test

check: Product schema (if ecommerce) includes accurate price, availability, and identifies match live product data (no stale/inflated data).
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Merchant Center diagnostics + Rich Results Test
recommended_fix: Wire schema fields to the live product-data source, not a cached or manual value.
validation_method: Merchant Center diagnostics show no mismatch errors

check: Video schema (if used) matches actual video presence, duration, and thumbnail.
recommended_fix: Correct or remove VideoObject schema that doesn't match the real video.
validation_method: Rich Results Test on a sample of video pages

check: No structured data implementation makes an inclusion, ranking, or AI-citation guarantee in its surrounding page copy or internal documentation.
recommended_fix: Rewrite any copy implying schema guarantees a result; state it as an eligibility/clarity aid instead.
validation_method: Editorial review sign-off per template

check: Structured data errors and warnings in Search Console's Enhancements reports are reviewed on a recurring cadence.
recommended_fix: Assign an owner to review and clear Enhancements report issues monthly.
validation_method: Confirm Enhancements report trend is flat or improving

check: A complete, tested 1:1 (or intentionally mapped) URL redirect plan exists before any domain, CMS, or URL-structure migration goes live.
dependency: Full crawl of the legacy site pre-migration
recommended_fix: Build the redirect map from a full legacy-site crawl, not from memory or a partial list.
validation_method: Test the full redirect map in staging before cutover
rollback_requirement: Yes — this workbook item's own subject is the rollback plan

check: Legacy XML sitemap remains available for a defined post-migration window to accelerate re-crawl of redirects.
recommended_fix: Keep the legacy sitemap live and submitted for 2–4 weeks post-cutover.
validation_method: Confirm Search Console still processes the legacy sitemap during the window

check: robots.txt on the new environment is verified to allow crawling before DNS cutover (a common migration failure point).
recommended_fix: Explicitly confirm and test robots.txt on the new environment before go-live.
validation_method: Fetch robots.txt on the new environment pre-cutover and re-check immediately post-cutover

check: Canonical tags on the new environment point to the new URLs, not leftover legacy or staging URLs.
recommended_fix: Fix canonical generation logic before go-live.
validation_method: Crawl staging/new environment and confirm canonical targets

check: A rollback plan and rollback trigger criteria (e.g., X% indexation or traffic drop) are documented before cutover.
recommended_fix: Document explicit numeric rollback triggers and the rollback procedure before go-live.
validation_method: Confirm runbook is reviewed and signed off pre-launch
rollback_requirement: Yes — this is the rollback plan itself

check: Search Console properties (and any verification methods) are set up for the new domain/subdomain before or immediately at cutover.
recommended_fix: Verify the new property and submit a Change of Address if the domain changed.
validation_method: Confirm new property shows crawl/index activity within 1–2 weeks

check: Post-migration monitoring (daily for the first 1–2 weeks) tracks index coverage, crawl errors, and organic traffic against baseline.
recommended_fix: Set up a daily monitoring cadence with a named owner for the first two weeks.
validation_method: Confirm daily checks occurred and are logged

check: Internal links across the migrated site point to new final-destination URLs, not through the redirect layer.
recommended_fix: Update internal links to point directly at new URLs instead of relying on redirects.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm internal links resolve with a single 200, not a redirect hop

check: Any URL-structure change preserves or improves click depth to revenue pages rather than burying them deeper.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Click-depth comparison, old vs. new IA
recommended_fix: Adjust the new IA so priority pages are not pushed deeper than before.
validation_method: Compare click-depth reports old vs. new

check: A defined re-audit (using this same workbook) is scheduled 30 and 90 days after a major migration.
recommended_fix: Schedule the two follow-up audits at migration sign-off.
validation_method: Confirm both scheduled audits occur and are logged

check: Faceted/filter combinations that have no independent search demand are excluded from indexation (noindex or parameter handling), not crawled and indexed by default.
recommended_fix: Apply noindex, canonical-to-parent, or crawl controls to low-value facet combinations.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm facet-combination index count drops to intended set

check: High-demand facet combinations (with real independent search volume) are made indexable and linked to, not accidentally blocked.
recommended_fix: Identify high-demand facets and deliberately make them indexable with real internal links.
validation_method: Confirm target facet URLs are indexed and receiving impressions

check: Out-of-stock products return an accurate status (not a silent 404) and either redirect to a relevant category or remain live with clear messaging.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Crawler status-code report on OOS product set
recommended_fix: Set an explicit out-of-stock handling policy per product lifecycle stage.
validation_method: Sample OOS products and confirm consistent handling

check: Product variant URLs (size/color) have a clear canonical strategy (self-canonical vs. canonical to parent) applied consistently.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Crawler canonical report on variant URLs
recommended_fix: Standardize the variant canonical strategy across the catalog.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm consistent canonical pattern

check: Pagination and 'load more'/infinite-scroll on category pages have a crawlable fallback (paginated URLs) for full catalog discovery.
recommended_fix: Add real paginated URLs behind or alongside the infinite-scroll UI.
validation_method: Confirm crawler reaches deep catalog pages via paginated URLs

check: Merchant feed / product structured data matches live price and availability (see also Structured Data section).
recommended_fix: Sync feed and schema generation to the live product-data source.
validation_method: Merchant Center diagnostics show no price/availability mismatch

check: Seasonal or discontinued category pages are handled deliberately (kept with a clear message, merged, or redirected) rather than left as thin or empty pages.
evidence_url_or_screenshot: Crawler thin-content report on seasonal set
recommended_fix: Apply a documented seasonal-page policy per category type.
validation_method: Spot-check seasonal pages against the documented policy

check: Internal site search result pages are excluded from indexation unless deliberately optimized as landing pages.
recommended_fix: Apply noindex to internal search result pages by default.
validation_method: Re-crawl and confirm search result pages are excluded

check: Every finding is scored for revenue risk (High/Medium/Low) and affected URL count, not just technical severity.
recommended_fix: Cross-reference findings against traffic/revenue data per affected template.
validation_method: Spot-check 10 rows for revenue-risk justification

check: A single ranked backlog exists (crawl/index blockers first, then architecture, then rendering/performance polish) rather than a flat, unordered list.
recommended_fix: Sequence the backlog using this workbook's severity and revenue-risk columns.
validation_method: Confirm backlog ordering matches the stated sequencing rule

check: Each backlog item has a named owner (not a team name only) and an effort estimate before work begins.
recommended_fix: Assign a specific individual owner and effort size to each item.
validation_method: Confirm 100% of open items have a named owner

check: Dependencies between fixes are documented so sequencing doesn't create rework (e.g., fixing canonicals before sitemap regeneration).
recommended_fix: Map dependency chains before assigning sprint order.
validation_method: Spot-check that dependent items are sequenced correctly

check: A rollback plan exists for every fix classified as needing one in this workbook, not only for full migrations.
recommended_fix: Require a rollback note before a flagged fix is marked ready for release.
validation_method: Spot-check rollback notes exist for flagged items

check: Stakeholders (dev, content, SEO, leadership) formally sign off on the prioritized roadmap before work starts.
recommended_fix: Circulate the roadmap for explicit sign-off before kickoff.
validation_method: Confirm sign-off record exists

check: Index coverage, crawl stats, and Core Web Vitals reports are reviewed on a fixed recurring cadence with a named owner.
recommended_fix: Assign a named owner and a fixed review cadence (e.g., monthly).
validation_method: Confirm reviews occurred on schedule for the last quarter

check: Alerting exists for sudden indexation drops, spikes in 404/5xx errors, or CWV regressions, not manual-only monitoring.
recommended_fix: Configure automated alerts for the listed regression types.
validation_method: Trigger a test condition and confirm the alert fires

check: A full re-audit using this workbook is scheduled at a fixed interval (this article recommends twice yearly) independent of any single migration.
recommended_fix: Add the recurring audit to a shared calendar with an owner.
validation_method: Confirm the next scheduled audit date exists

check: Tool-reported scores (crawler health score, PSI score, etc.) are treated as proxies and cross-checked against real index coverage and traffic, not reported as outcomes on their own.
recommended_fix: Pair every tool score in reporting with a real outcome metric.
validation_method: Review the next stakeholder report for paired metrics

check: Findings and fixes from this workbook are logged with dates so regression (a previously fixed issue reappearing) can be detected.
recommended_fix: Keep dated workbook versions rather than overwriting in place.
validation_method: Confirm a prior-period workbook snapshot exists for comparison

check: Re-verification against current Google Search Central and web.dev documentation happens at each recurring audit, since thresholds and guidance change over time.
recommended_fix: Add a documentation-currency check as the first step of every re-audit.
validation_method: Confirm the workbook cites documentation accessed within the last 6 months
